title.narrative: Integrated Response to the Threat of Explosive Ordnance in Northern Ethiopia (CERF 2025)

description.narrative:
Ethiopia has experienced a series of internal and international armed conflicts throughout its history, leaving a legacy of landmines and explosive ordnance scattered throughout the country. The outbreak of conflict in November 2020 between the central government and the regional authorities of the Tigray region, which spilled over into the neighboring Afar and Amhara regions in 2021, has added new explosive contamination. 

This project will mitigate the threat posed by explosive ordnance through the:
- Identification, registration and marking of EO in 15, previously unassessed woredas in Tigray, Afar and Amhara regions 
- Provision of Explosive Hazard Awareness Training (EHAT) to 250 humanitarian and development partners active in the EO affected regions/woredas
- Delivery of Explosive Ordnance Risk Education (EORE) to 600 people from communities confronted with explosive hazards

Since 1997, UNOPS has been working with the United Nations Mine Action Service (UNMAS) to help make the world a safer place.
